newsitem.title: INDIA: India to react "constructively" to Pakistan offer.
newsitem.headline: India to react "constructively" to Pakistan offer.

text.p: India will respond "constructively" to a Pakistani offer of talks over Kashmir, officials said on Thursday.
"India's response is already known. The Prime Minister has already said that we are ready to react to it constructively," a senior official told Reuters on condition of anonymity.
Earlier on Thursday, Pakistan's new Prime Minister Nawaz Sharif proposed talks with his Indian counterpart H.D. Deve Gowda.

In a letter to Deve Gowda, copies of which were released by the Pakistani Foreign Ministry in Islamabad, he said that their meeting should be preceded by preparatory talks between the foreign ministry secretaries of the two countries.
The Indian official said: "The letter has to come through their normal diplomatic channels. The modalities have to be worked out."

An Indian foreign ministry official told Reuters: "Until we see the letter, we cannot say anything. Let us see it first." He added that New Delhi had noted that Pakistan was making Kashmir a "core issue".
